title: 第1章  阴阳造化诀
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“掌门，你冷静一点，我不是那种随便的人……”
太玄宗。
杂役弟子住处。
一间简陋的房间内。
一位容颜无双、身姿曼妙的绝色女子，一双玉臂犹如八爪鱼一般，死死地缠在叶长天的脖子上。
绝色女子正是太玄宗高高在上的美女掌门，夏秋水。
看着夏秋水近在咫尺的绝美脸庞，叶长天好一会儿都没能回过神来。
他本是地球上一位牛马上班族，因为年少不知肾精贵，年纪轻轻就成为一名资深送奶工，经常被女朋友嫌弃。
今天路过一地摊的时候，地摊老板给他推荐了一本阴阳造化诀。
据说修炼阴阳造化诀，能让他变得龙精虎猛，战斗力爆表。
叶长天抱着试一试的心态，将阴阳造化诀买了回去。
谁知道他照着阴阳造化诀修炼，阴阳造化诀直接出现在他脑海里，然后就带着他莫名其妙穿越到这个玄幻世界，成为太玄宗一位与他同名同姓的杂役弟子。
还未等他适应这个新的身份，掌门夏秋水就突然闯入他的房间，直接扑进了他怀里。
“掌门这是中情毒了？”
叶长天目光在夏秋水身上一扫。
面色潮红，眼神迷离。
这一看就是被下药了！
看着夏秋水动人的模样，叶长天不由暗自吞了口唾沫，强行安奈住了心头的冲动。
他虽然有那个心，但真没那个胆啊。
这一位可是太玄宗的高冷绝色掌门，元婴境大佬。

要是真发生点什么，等夏秋水清醒过来，得知自己毁了她清白，那还不得一剑把他给剁了？
“掌门，快醒醒，你不能这样……”
叶长天定了定神，连忙急声唤了起来。
叶长天的呼叫声，也是令得夏秋水美眸中恢复了几分清明。
她猛地一把推开叶长天，迅速盘腿打坐，强行压制着那不断刺激着自己神经的情毒，让自己保持着最后一丝理智，对着叶长天道：
“你叫什么名字？”
叶长天连忙答道：“掌门，我叫叶长天，是太玄宗的杂役弟子。”
“叶长天，你速速去离火宫，替本掌门将炼丹大师火凤儿请来！”
夏秋水紧咬牙关，对着叶长天命令道。
叶长天看了夏秋水一眼，苦笑道：“掌门，我只是一名杂役弟子，哪有资格去离火宫，就算我真能去，你能坚持得住吗？”
夏秋水面色阴沉得快要滴出水来。
不久前。
她得知万魔宫天阳老魔的踪迹，前去追杀那位天阳老魔，结果大意之下遭遇对方的埋伏，中了对方一种极为霸道的情毒。
夏秋水只能强行压制情毒，第一时间回到了太玄宗。
只是……
夏秋水还没来得及去离火宫找火凤儿解毒，情毒就彻底爆发。
夏秋水在最后一丝理智尚存的时候，降落在了杂役峰，随便找了个房间闯了进去。
现在虽然叶长天唤醒了她一丝理智。
但她根本支撑不了太久。
杂役峰距离主峰的离火宫，还有着一段距离。

叶长天不过是个练气一层的杂役弟子，就算拿着她的信物现在赶去离火宫，等火凤儿得到消息后，恐怕黄花菜都凉了。
而她现在全力压制情毒。
一旦调动体内法力，恐怕最后一丝理智都会瞬间吞没，根本无法联系火凤儿。
最重要的是。
夏秋水隐约能够感觉到，她这次中的情毒很诡异，就算火凤儿也未必解决得了。
“让你去你就去，哪来的那么多废话！”
夏秋水用足以杀人的盯着叶长天：“你要是再不走，信不信我现在就杀了你？”
她已经快要压制不住了。
没有叶长天这个男人在房间内，她或许还能坚持一二。
要是继续让叶长天这么一个帅气的男子在她面前晃悠，她恐怕又要失去理智扑上去了。
不能留这个男人在房间！
她体质与修炼的功法都非常特殊。
宁愿去死，她也绝不能失去元阴！
“……”
叶长天顿时只感觉背脊一片发凉。
要是再不走，夏秋水绝对会毫不犹豫地给她一剑。
出了房间。
叶长天本想尽人事、听天命，去离火宫给夏秋水送信。
可脑海中却总是有着一种莫名的力量，试图让叶长天留下来，甚至冲进房间去把夏秋水办了。
叶长天极力想要克制，却根本难以压制那股强烈的冲动。

很快的。
叶长天就发现。
这种力量的源头，似乎就来自脑海中的阴阳造化诀！
自从穿越过来后，这本从地摊上买来的古籍就莫名其妙出现在了叶长天的脑海中。
他也得到了不少关于阴阳造化诀的信息。
阴阳造化诀！
这是一门夺天地造化的双修功法。
修炼此功法，无需灵根，无需天赋，无需悟性，只需通过双修，就能不断提升实力！
双修对象天赋实力越强，获得的好处也越大。
夏秋水身为太玄宗掌门，不仅天资绝世，而且还是太玄宗最年轻的元婴强者！
若是能与夏秋水修炼一次，那还不得起飞？
叶长天内心挣扎起来。
上还是不上？
身为一名伪灵根的废物。
叶长天来到太玄宗三年，修为一直停留在练气一层，在太玄宗受尽了屈辱与白眼。
就连未婚妻都瞧不起他，甚至已经投入别人的怀抱，要与他退婚。
叶长天又岂能甘心？
而现在。
阴阳造化诀简直就是为他这位伪灵根废物量身打造的功法！
只要他冲进房间，与夏秋水完成一次修炼，或许就能逆天改命！

“妈的，拼了！”
叶长天咬了咬牙。
撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的。
他若是就此离开，夏秋水的情毒不能及时解决，恐怕必死无疑。
现在冲进去，至少能救夏秋水的性命。
到时候。
他好歹也是夏秋水的救命恩人。
夏秋水总不至于真的将他这个救命恩人干掉吧？
就算真被干掉，与这样一位绝世美女拥有一夜情缘，那也没有白穿越一回！
叶长天不再犹豫，砰地一下推开房门冲进了房间……
content_en:
"Master, please calm down, I'm not the kind of casual person..."
Taixuanzong.
The residence of the handyman disciples.
In a simple room.
A stunning woman with unparalleled appearance and graceful figure, with a pair of jade arms like an octopus, tightly wrapped around Ye Changtian's neck.
The stunning woman is none other than Xia Qiushui, the high-ranking beauty leader of Taixuan Sect.
Looking at Xia Qiushui's beautiful face so close at hand, Ye Changtian couldn't come back to his senses for a while.
He was originally a cow-horse office worker on earth. Because he didn't know the importance of kidneys when he was young, he became a senior milkman at a young age and was often disliked by his girlfriend.
When he passed by a street stall today, the stall owner recommended a Yin-Yang Art of Creation to him.
It is said that practicing the Yin and Yang Creation Technique can make him become a dragon and a tiger, with explosive fighting power.
Ye Changtian bought the Yin Yang Creation Jue with the intention of giving it a try.
Who knew that he was practicing according to the Yin-Yang Creation Art, and the Yin-Yang Creation Art appeared directly in his mind, and then led him to this fantasy world inexplicably, and became a handyman disciple of Taixuan Sect with the same name as him.
Before he could adapt to this new identity, the head Xia Qiushui suddenly broke into his room and threw himself into his arms.
"Is the leader poisoned by love?"
Ye Changtian glanced at Xia Qiushui.
His face was flushed and his eyes were blurred.
This looks like he has been drugged!
Seeing Xia Qiushui's moving appearance, Ye Changtian couldn't help but secretly swallowed his saliva and forcibly suppressed the impulse in his heart.
Although he has the heart, he really doesn't have the courage.
This person is the aloof and stunning head of Taixuan Sect, a big boss in the Nascent Soul Realm.
If something really happens, when Xia Qiushui wakes up and realizes that he has ruined her innocence, then why not chop him into pieces with a sword?
"Master, wake up quickly, you can't do this..."
Ye Changtian calmed down and called out quickly.
Ye Changtian's call also restored some clarity in Xia Qiushui's beautiful eyes.
She pushed Ye Changtian away suddenly, and quickly sat down cross-legged to meditate, suppressing the love poison that was constantly stimulating her nerves, allowing herself to maintain the last trace of reason, and said to Ye Changtian:
"What's your name?"
Ye Changtian quickly replied: "Master, my name is Ye Changtian, and I am a handyman disciple of Taixuan Sect."
"Ye Changtian, go to Lihuo Palace quickly and invite the alchemy master Huo Feng'er on my behalf!"
Xia Qiushui gritted her teeth and ordered Ye Changtian.
Ye Changtian glanced at Xia Qiushui and said with a bitter smile: "Master, I am just a handyman disciple. How can I be qualified to go to Lihuo Palace? Even if I can really go, can you hold on?"
The water in Xia Qiu was so gloomy that it almost dripped water.
Not long ago.
She learned about the traces of the old demon Tianyang from the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons, and went to hunt down the old demon Tianyang. As a result, she was ambushed by the other party and was poisoned by an extremely domineering love poison.
Xia Qiushui could only suppress the love poison and returned to Taixuan Sect immediately.
Just...
Before Xia Qiushui had time to go to Lihuo Palace to find Huo Feng'er to detoxify her, the love poison completely broke out.
When Xia Qiushui had the last trace of sanity left, he landed on the Miscellaneous Peak, found a random room and broke in.
Now although Ye Changtian has awakened her sense.
But she couldn't hold on for long.
The Miscellaneous Service Peak is still some distance away from the main peak, the Lihuo Palace.
Ye Changtian is just a handyman disciple at the first level of Qi training. Even if he takes her token and rushes to Lihuo Palace now, when Huo Feng'er gets the news, the day lily will probably be cold.
And now she is trying her best to suppress the love poison.
Once the magic power in the body is mobilized, the last trace of reason will probably be swallowed up instantly, making it impossible to contact Huo Feng'er.
The most important thing is.
Xia Qiushui could vaguely feel that the love poison in her this time was very strange, and even Huo Feng'er might not be able to solve it.
"Just go if you are told, where does all this nonsense come from!"
Xia Qiushui used enough to kill peopleStaring at Ye Changtian: "If you don't leave, believe it or not, I will kill you now?"
She could hardly hold herself back any longer.
Without the man Ye Changtian in the room, she might be able to hold on for a while.
If she continued to let a handsome man like Ye Changtian hang out in front of her, she might lose her mind and pounce on him again.
You can't leave this man in the room!
Her physique and the techniques she practices are very special.
She would rather die than lose her Yuan Yin!
"..."
Ye Changtian suddenly felt a chill running down his spine.
If she didn't leave, Xia Qiushui would definitely give her a sword without hesitation.
Out of the room.
Ye Changtian originally thought of doing everything possible and obeying fate, and went to Lihuo Palace to deliver a message to Xia Qiushui.
But there was always an inexplicable force in his mind, trying to make Ye Changtian stay, and even rushed into the room to do something with Xia Qiushui.
Ye Changtian tried his best to restrain himself, but it was impossible to suppress the strong impulse.
Very quickly.
Ye Changtian discovered it.
The source of this power seems to come from the Yin and Yang Creation Technique in the mind!
Ever since he traveled through time, this ancient book bought from a street stall had appeared in Ye Changtian's mind for no apparent reason.
He also got a lot of information about the Yin and Yang Creation Technique.
Yin-Yang Creation Technique!
This is a dual cultivation method that conquers the heaven and earth.
To practice this technique, you don’t need spiritual roots, talent, or understanding. You can continuously improve your strength through dual cultivation!
The stronger the talent and strength of the dual cultivation object, the greater the benefits obtained.
As the head of Taixuan Sect, Xia Qiushui is not only extremely talented, but he is also the youngest Nascent Soul expert in Taixuan Sect!
If you can practice with Xia Qiushui once, then you are still not allowed to take off?
Ye Changtian struggled internally.
On or off?
As a waste with false spiritual roots.
Ye Changtian came to Taixuanzong for three years, but his cultivation has been stuck at the first level of Qi training, and he suffered all the humiliation and contempt in Taixuanzong.
Even his fiancée looked down upon him and even fell into the arms of someone else, wanting to break off the engagement with him.
How could Ye Changtian be willing to do so?
And now.
The Yin-Yang Creation Technique is simply a technique tailor-made for this waste of pseudo-spiritual roots!
As long as he rushes into the room and completes a practice with Xia Qiushui, he may be able to change his fate against the will of heaven!
"Damn it, let's fight!"
Ye Changtian gritted his teeth.
The bold ones will be starved to death, and the timid ones will be starved to death.
If he left like this, if Xia Qiushui's love poison could not be resolved in time, he would definitely die.
Rushing in now can at least save Xia Qiushui's life.
That's when.
After all, he was Xia Qiushui's savior.
Xia Qiushui wouldn't really kill his savior, right?
Even if you are really killed and have a one-night stand with such a peerless beauty, your journey through time will not be in vain!
Ye Changtian no longer hesitated, pushed open the door and rushed into the room...
